title: University Student Identity Card (Blue Lanyard)
description: Misplaced my student ID card near the reading room on the second floor of the Main Library. It is held in a clear sleeve attached to a woven blue lanyard.

title: Student ID Card Found Outside Library Entrance
description: Found a university student ID card in a transparent holder with a blue strap on the stone bench just outside the Main Library steps. Deposited safely for claim verification.

title: Matte Black Smartphone in Navy Silicone Case
description: Left my black Android smartphone on a corner table in the Central Cafeteria after lunch. The phone has a navy blue matte silicone case and a small scuff near the camera rim.

title: Android Phone Left on Cafeteria Table
description: Picked up a locked black smartphone inside a dark blue soft cover near the north window of the Central Cafeteria. Handed over to the campus lost-and-found desk.

title: Introduction to Algorithms Textbook (CLRS)
description: Forgot my paperback algorithms reference book in the Computer Lab after the afternoon session. It has pastel index tabs on chapters 6 and 15 and light pencil notes on the flyleaf.

title: Key Ring with Three Keys & Leather Tag
description: Found a silver key ring holding one hostel room key and two smaller locker keys with a tan leather tag near the bicycle stand at the Parking Area.

title: Charcoal Grey Laptop Backpack
description: Left a charcoal grey canvas laptop backpack in row G of the Auditorium after the seminar. Contains a steel water bottle, a lined notebook, and a pen pouch.

title: Grey Canvas Backpack Found in Auditorium
description: Found a dark grey laptop backpack under a seat in the Auditorium following the evening talk. Holds a metal water flask and stationery.

title: Compact White Wireless Earbuds Charging Case
description: Dropped a small pebble-shaped white charging case for wireless earphones near the notice kiosk in the Student Center. Left earbud was inside the case.

title: Algorithms Textbook Left on Lab Workstation
description: Found an Introduction to Algorithms textbook with colored page tabs on workstation 14 in the Computer Lab at the end of the lab hour.
